desc:
Brand: Betty Crocker

Flavor: Peanut Butter with Reese’s Pieces Minis and mini chocolate chips

Net Weight: 337 g (11.9 oz)

Cookie Yield: Makes approximately 15 cookies

Prep Required: Just add butter and one egg

Bake Time: About 10–12 minutes

Ideal Use: Quick homemade cookies with a candy twist
features:
Features

Infused with Reese’s Pieces Minis: Includes mini Reese’s candy and mini chocolate chips blended into a rich peanut butter cookie base.

Quick prep time: Just add butter and an egg—no complex mixing or measuring required.

Small batch convenience: 337 g pouch yields about 15 cookies, ideal for small families or quick dessert needs.

Classic flavor pairing: Combines smooth peanut butter with chocolate candy for a nostalgic, indulgent taste.

Reliable quality: From Betty Crocker—a well-known, trusted baking brand.

Colorful and fun: Reese’s Pieces add visual appeal, texture, and excitement to each bite.

Allergen information: Contains wheat, peanuts, soy, and milk. May contain eggs. 

Benefits

Perfect for peanut butter lovers: Offers that signature Reese’s taste in warm, freshly baked cookies.

No-fuss baking: Great for beginners or quick desserts without sacrificing flavor or presentation.

Great for families: Kids love the candy mix-ins, and adults love the easy prep.

Ideal for entertaining: Whether it’s a bake sale, party tray, or after-dinner treat—these cookies are always a hit.

Time-saving solution: Saves you from making cookie dough from scratch while still delivering a homemade feel.

Customizable: Can be jazzed up with extra nuts, candies, or used in cookie sandwiches and layered desserts.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Sugar, Brown Sugar, Peanut Butter (peanuts, dextrose, hydrogenated canola and cottonseed oil, salt), REESE'S PIECES Minis (sugar, partially defatted peanuts, hydrogenated vegetable oil [palm kernel and soybean], corn syrup, dextrose, palm kernel oil, artificial color [yellow 5 lake, yellow 6 lake, red 40 lake, blue 1 lake], salt, soy lecithin, resinous glaze, carnauba wax, artificial flavor, milk), Chocolate Chips (sugar, chocolate liquor, cocoa butter, soy lecithin, artificial flavor), Palm Oil, Baking Soda, Salt, Nonfat Milk.
